definitions.explanation: The standard or grade of excellence of a product or manufactured good.

examples.japanese: {品質|ひんしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
{品質|ひんしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。
⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、{品質|ひんしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's expensive. But the quality is good.

notes:
{品質|ひんしつ} refers specifically to the quality of manufactured products or goods. It is narrower than ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧, which covers quality in general.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {品質|ひんしつ}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: quality control (QC)
- {品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}: quality assurance (QA)
- {高|こう}{品質|ひんしつ}: high quality
- {品質|ひんしつ}{向上|こうじょう}: quality improvement
- {品質|ひんしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: quality declines

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {品質|ひんしつ}: product/goods quality (business, manufacturing)
- ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧: quality in general (⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ = sleep quality)
- ⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧: quality/class of a person or thing (broader, sometimes character)

REGISTER:
Common in business, manufacturing, and consumer contexts. Often seen in product reviews and advertising.
